concept.title: Be sure the exhaust system does not leak

keywords.indexterm: be sure the exhaust system does not leak

li.p: Check the exhaust system whenever the vehicle is raised for changing the oil or any other purpose.

If you hear a change in the sound of the exhaust, or if you drive over something that strikes the underbody of the vehicle, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: Do not inhale exhaust fumes or leave your engine running in an enclosed area for a prolonged period of time. Exhaust fumes contain carbon monoxide, a colorless and odorless gas that can cause unconsciousness and death by asphyxiation.
Do not drive with the tailgate open. Poisonous exhaust fumes can enter the passenger compartment. If you must drive with the tailgate open, proceed as follows:

li.p: Set the air intake control to external air intake, the mode selection to or , and the fan speed to the highest setting.
